identity_rule: Bind product source revision separately from later evidence-only commit/materialized ref. Use existing commit/tag; never embed an unknowable self commit SHA. Hash exact Git blob bytes without checkout newline conversion.
blocking: all frozen automated tests and affected regressions
runnable Windows/Web/Android artifacts and exact source/build identity
actual binding/control-path automated evidence, separately labeled from human UI observations
physical_observations: Retain as pending until actually observed; no fake physical PASS or implementation-complete claim based on declarations only.
